title: chatIds AND kinds filter can silently produce no-push
description: §4.1: if both chatIds and kinds are present, push is enabled only for chats whose id is in chatIds AND whose kind is in kinds. A misconfigured client that lists a channel's chatId but kinds=['direct'] gets no push with no error. A non-normative note warning about this silent AND-semantics trap would help implementers.
close_reason: Added non-normative note about AND-semantics trap after §4.1
